title: 侧拉找平衡
description: 细线漫画风中，成人用侧拉点与对侧脚点形成稳定平衡。

art_direction.medium: opaque gouache illustration with broad matte brush marks
art_direction.scene: An original fine-line comic illustration depicts a fictional adult balancing from a low sidepull on an indoor bouldering wall. A lime-green handhold faces sideways, and an opposing foothold allows the hips to shift gently toward it while the free hand reaches a nearby rounded edge. The climber wears an opaque burgundy shirt and dark trousers, with realistic shoulders and no oversized head. Keep all action low over clearly continuous crash mats. Frame the whole body diagonally across the page with quiet gray wall geometry and selective color accents. Show plausible grip orientation and shoe contact. Include no speech bubbles, text, branded equipment, jumping, or exposed climbing.
